scope: Stable legible lighting as the camera moves, clear high-density phone rendering with usable quality choices, recovery after mobile backgrounding or graphics loss that preserves the world and authoring session, and intuitive house interior entry and exterior return with playable desktop/phone controls.

intuitiveness.evidence: The retained renderer and mobile journeys demonstrate reachable movement, authoring, quality, drawer, Export and retry controls across the declared desktop-emulated phone layouts. The named-room delta adds a complete Bay 5 laboratory and nested shelf path, with usable phone controls after recovery. The corrected saved-workspace path gives a useful retry message for immediate read abort, late abort and synchronous JavaScript failure. Physical phone control and lifecycle behavior remain unverified.

accuracy.evidence: Source inspection confirms transaction-complete saved-data publication and request-error, transaction-abort and synchronous-throw handling. The retained 35 storage checks and 24 entry checks compare exact world/history/future/selection/camera state. The new named-room run adds actual graphics loss, exact six-bay laboratory and nested-object context, fresh rendered ray picking before and after recovery, and preservation of unrelated nodes. Candidate source/artifact provenance is frozen and bound. The evidence still uses desktop Chromium emulation and cannot establish the affected physical Android/Brave device or its GPU/lifecycle behavior.

wowFactor.evidence: The candidate surface sweep provides 48 baseline/candidate captures across desktop, landscape and portrait layouts, None and Toon styles, seven camera states, entry and quality choices, with empty error and shader-failure diagnostics. Inspection shows broader irregular interior material variation, clearer None views, a useful desktop Orbit composition and readable high-density phone controls; the new room capture shows a populated Bay 5 authoring context. Toon remains intentionally high contrast and some first-person framing still gives the ceiling substantial area, so these are bounded visual improvements rather than a claim of finished art direction.

thinkingOutOfTheBox.evidence: The implementation combines stationary fill-light gain only while an enclosed portal room is active, procedural noise that is filtered by pixel footprint, a modest initial downward room pitch and a larger-axis first-person field of view. Alongside transaction-complete storage and fresh-engine recovery, this addresses lighting, material readability, authoring continuity and failure recovery through small compatible changes. The room fixture proves the same approach with an actual named plan, nested selection and post-loss picking.

Candidate final errors and shader diagnostics are empty, the authored world is held constant apart from solve timing, and the provenance binds the current source, pinned engine and artifacts.

limitations: This is a retained-evidence delta re-review; Luna did not rerun browser, native or GPU suites because the candidate and named-room sources were frozen and the targeted successful runs were available.

The 48-view surface matrix, 24 named-room checks and earlier 35 storage checks use deterministic instrumentation under desktop Chromium. They do not measure physical-phone GPU precision, thermal behavior, OS process discard, physical FPS or spontaneous browser delivery after worker termination.

The storage evidence covers read/write transaction boundaries and size preflight. It does not claim every browser quota or blocked-database condition; those are separate availability cases if the product acceptance matrix requires them. The named-room path is the exercised six-bay/Bay 5 plan and does not imply every future room plan.

The candidate improves representative material and camera views but does not establish finished art direction for every surface, device density, audio/performance target or release deployment. Full catalog and world-creator requirements remain separate gates.
